purpose: Prove that the materialized DESI DR2 BAO and Pantheon+ blocks are internally coherent enough to enter a declared joint-likelihood branch, without treating compatibility as model confirmation.

desi_dr2.title: DESI DR2 Results II: Measurements of Baryon Acoustic Oscillations and Cosmological Constraints

method_facts.galaxy_quasar_reconstruction: IterativeFFT implemented in pyrecon using fiducial DR1 settings
method_facts.bao_covariance: RascalC semi-analytical covariance for galaxy/quasar correlation functions; reported distance constraints include systematic error budget
method_facts.distance_basis: DM_over_rd and DH_over_rd are a rotation-equivalent basis to DV_over_rd and DM_over_DH for consistency calculations
method_facts.fiducial_cosmology_boundary: reported final distance measurements and uncertainties are stated not to depend on fiducial cosmology when conversion is correctly performed
method_facts.supernova_combination: DESI publication performs cosmological fits with Pantheon+ as one of the external SN likelihoods

pantheon_plus.covariance_policy: statistical plus systematic covariance retained in cosmological fits

eta_z.definition: number of canonical DESI BAO observables whose z_eff lies inside the materialized Pantheon+ zHD span divided by 13
eta_z.role: coverage diagnostic only; not a standard external cosmological statistic
eta_z.branch_rule: DESI points beyond the SN maximum redshift are an explicit high-z extension, not an incompatibility

f_ap.definition: F_AP_proxy = (DM/rd)/(DH/rd) = DM/DH for each anisotropic DESI tracer
f_ap.pass_rule: repo-local ratio must agree with the rounded primary-publication DM/DH ratio within one published sigma
f_ap.role: source-table transcription/order/observable consistency gate; not a new DESI reanalysis

sn_sample.pass_rule: materialized catalog must retain 1701 rows, 77 calibrator rows and 1624 non-calibrator/cosmology rows

reconstruction.pass_rule: primary-publication reconstruction and systematic treatment must be recorded before joint use
reconstruction.residual: RLL does not independently rerun DESI catalog-level reconstruction in this gate

joint_branch.name: DESI_DR2_BAO_PLUS_PANTHEON_STAT_SYS
joint_branch.reason: These residuals remain visible; the primary DESI cosmology publication itself evaluates DESI with Pantheon+ as an external SN likelihood, so they do not authorize a claim but do not make the data blocks unusable for a separately declared likelihood branch.
